supportingSources.label: Earth Wind Fire play and rules account

strategy.overview: Earth Wind Fire rewards repeated completion of its ten numbered standups, while the upper rollover lanes build the bonus multiplier and a top Special. Complete the drop bank to light the outlane ball-return feature. The top-right lane target advances its own award. When the Fire Special hole is lit, shoot it to collect the current value. A timed bonus round adds a late-ball scoring window.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete the ten numbered standup targets repeatedly to build the Fire Special route. Complete the three upper rollovers to raise Bonus X and work toward the top Special. Complete the drop bank to light the outlane ball return, and shoot the Fire Special hole whenever its award is lit.
strategy.summary: Finish the numbered set closest to completion, use the upper rollovers for Bonus X, and take the Fire Special hole only when its lamp shows a worthwhile award. Build ball return from the drop bank when safety matters more than raw points.

quickInfo.name: Build Fire Special
quickInfo.summary: Complete the ten numbered standups repeatedly.

quickInfo.name: Collect Fire
quickInfo.summary: Shoot the lit Fire Special hole.

steps.text: Complete the ten numbered standup targets; repeated completions advance the Fire Special route.
Complete the three upper rollovers to advance Bonus X and the upper Special sequence.
Complete the drop-target bank to light the outlane ball-return feature.
Shoot the Fire Special hole when its lamp is lit, and use the top-right lane target to advance its displayed award.

alternatives.title: Favor survival
alternatives.when: Use this when the numbered standups are rejecting the ball.

steps.text: Complete the drop bank to light ball return.
Use upper rollovers for Bonus X before returning to the standups.
Keep completing the numbered set until the Fire route reaches its lit collect.
Shoot the Fire Special hole while that award is available.

machineSetup: Check the numbered-target Special threshold, Bonus X limit, ball-return behavior, timed bonus round, and Special awards.
Test all ten standups, three upper rollovers, drop bank, Fire Special hole, top-right lane target, return gate, and award lamps.

cautions.issue: The number of target-set completions needed for Special can vary by setup.
cautions.response: Follow the Fire lamps instead of assuming one fixed completion count.
